subject: orchid
name: 兰花
label: 弯枝兰花
learning: 先观察主体各部分怎样连接，再挑几处有特点的细节。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. MEDIUM reference: an elegant observational picture-book drawing with a clear coherent silhouette, 6–10 separated distinguishing structural details and natural joined parts. Richer form than an icon, without intricate texture or dense repeated marks. One arching orchid spray with two fully open flowers and one large bud, recognizable lips and broad petals, two long leaves at the base.
Composition check: complete subject centered inside the central 76% of the square with generous 12% clear margins. Only outlines with open white interiors. Flower centers and petals are simplified broad shapes without dense repeated tiny marks.
